title: Grilled Brazilian Skewers with Charred Myeongnan
description: A fusion of flavors with the bold taste of Brazilian spices and the delicate sweetness of charred Myeongnan. Serve with a side of lightly charred vegetables.

ingredients.name: Brazilian Skewers
ingredients.notes: made with marinated tofu and vegetables

ingredients.name: Lightly Charred Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers and onions

ingredients.name: Brazilian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: make your own with chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Brazilian Spice Blend and lime juice to make the marinade.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and coat with the marinade.
Let the skewers marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the Myeongnan and lightly charred vegetables onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with roe and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of lightly charred vegetables.
